review_note: Authored from source inspection on the heads below. ASTRA has not reviewed these entries and T8 has not answered the two route questions. Entries marked basis inspected_source are judgements about where machinery lives, not evidence that a schedule was driven through it.

bound_to.note: Relevant identity changes invalidate every entry until revalidated. The producer records the digests it actually read; a digest mismatch invalidates this map rather than carrying it across.

units.note: Capability is not the opcode. An entry declares which tuple decides it, because opcode membership omits actor, selector, target, direction, schema, barriers and transport.

arm_fault.kind.note: An explicit closed list, so membership is an enumeration rather than a resemblance. A kind outside it is a real-route capability, not an unclassified op.

await_event.event.note: Four of the contract's seven are refused by name. Binding one to a neighbouring event would make the adapter the author of the scenario's meaning.

answer_relist.evidence: no occurrence of relist, next_page or cursor machinery anywhere in proxy/, client/ or destination/
answer_relist.caveat: absence by inspection is not proof of exhaustive absence; it is a located judgement, revalidated when the route identity changes

answer_next_page.evidence: as answer_relist: no pagination machinery in the mediator
answer_next_page.caveat: absence by inspection is not proof of exhaustive absence

set_pin_state.evidence: T9 ruling 2026-09-14 04:03: pin is a real-route capability only T8's proxy will have

assert_no_implicit_approval_or_pin_write.evidence: T9 ruling 2026-09-14 04:03, approval and pin families

invoke_real_doctor.evidence: T9 ruling 2026-09-14 04:03, doctor family; the operation names the real product surface

invoke_real_install.evidence: the operation invokes the real installation entry point; the stand-in mediator has no installer

execute_config_transaction_profile.evidence: config transaction machinery is a product surface; absent from the mediator

snapshot_private_config_bytes_and_mode.evidence: reads real private configuration bytes and mode; absent from the mediator

compare_config_bytes_entries_mode_and_cl.evidence: compares real configuration state; absent from the mediator

assert_no_second_forward_and_no_pending_.open_question: whether the mediator can express this at all is a question about T8's real route, not about the adapter

assert_secondary_and_reverse_complete_in.open_question: as above: a route question, not an adapter question

execute_armed_worker_fault.open_question: fault dispatch machinery exists at proxy/fault_dispatch.py, but a word occurring in the mediator does not establish that a schedule can be driven through it. Needs a route-based answer or an executed witness.

release_fault_barrier.open_question: release and barrier machinery is present (fault_dispatch.py:100, passthrough.py:349) but integration is unevidenced; presence of a symbol is not integration

release_any_old_workers.open_question: discard machinery present (passthrough.py:375) but no evidence a schedule drives it

assert_pending_retired.open_question: retirement is emitted at passthrough.py:528 but whether the adapter can assert it is unevidenced
